I saved the draft to Hollis and answered you in our DM. It hasn't been sent; someone still needs to send it.

- To: Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)
- Subject: Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate
- Body: the $2,101 per-seat rate, a note that it came from Marcus Lindqvist, and a note that you approved sharing it. It also asks Hollis not to pass the figure on without your or June's sign-off.

Why the approvals check out:
- Hollis leads the Central team and doesn't own Thornbury Cloth Co.; Marcus does. So sharing the rate with Hollis needed approval from you or June, and your message gives it.
- The address is internal (pemberline.com), so the draft didn't need Ruth Calloway's approval.

I took the $2,101 figure from your message. I didn't find it in any file I looked at, and those don't contain a 2027 rate. The signed renewal order form shows the current rate of $1,700 a seat for 40 seats, running through 2/28/27.
